comment: A heater shield, 0.48 m by 0.62 m: wooden boards faced with a sheet of iron and bound at the edge in steel, carried on a grip and a forearm strap. The face does not burn and a blade only scores it; the boards behind it will still catch. Regenerate with scripts/gen_shield_items.py; the hilt box is emitted from the same constants that build the mesh, so the fist cannot drift off the grip.
name: heater_shield
